description:
Use this when the user wants the sound of a clip changed: "mute the original audio", "remove the background
noise", "make me sound like a robot", "the music is too loud".
Not for: adding or changing the song (edit_clip) or sound effects (add_to_clip). Undoable (undo_edit). Costs no
Horizon Units. Returns job_id; job_status waits for it. Options the account can't use are refused by name.

denoise.description: Background noise removal strength, 0 to 100. 0 is off, e.g. 50.

ducking_db.description: How far the music dips under speech, in dB, 0 to 30, e.g. 12. Turns ducking on.

music_ducking.description: True makes the music dip while someone talks, false stops it. Leave out to keep it. Needs music on the clip.

music_volume.description: Music level: quiet, normal, loud, or a percent from 0 to 400 (100 is the usual level under speech), e.g. 60. Needs music on the clip.

mute_original.description: True mutes the clip's own sound, false turns it back on. Leave out to keep it.

normalize.description: True evens out loudness, false leaves it as recorded. Leave out to keep it.

original_volume.description: Volume of the clip's own sound in percent, 0 to 1000. 100 is as recorded, e.g. 150.

voice_boost.description: Makes speech clearer, 0 to 100. 0 is off, e.g. 40.

voice_effect.description: Voice filter by name, e.g. robot, deep, chipmunk, echo, telephone, megaphone, radio or cave, or off to remove it. Empty keeps the current one.

name: mix_audio
title: Mix the sound
